scope: Proposition 9.8 (The component trees) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 70. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every component of the actual switch graph is a tree. For a nonisolated component with stabilizer A and S = A ∩ L, there is an integer r ≥ 2 such that S is a nested union of rank-r free groups and dimDL H1(S; DL) = r − 1. These approximants and S have injective ambient first-homology maps. Moreover A is finitely generated, quasiconvex, virtually compact special, and field-acyclic.
